title: R1/R2-series qualifying residential site - alternative maximum base height and building height (section 23-424)
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of the ALTERNATIVE height envelope available to R1-1, R1-2, R1-2A, R2, R2A, and R2X on a QUALIFYING RESIDENTIAL SITE per NYC Zoning Resolution section 23-424 (City of Yes, Last Amended 2024-12-05, captured via the official print/PDF channel: docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/zr-23-424-r1-r2.snapshot.json): maximum base height 35 ft, maximum building height 35 ft (this row carries NO headroom above the base height, unlike the R4 row - 35/45 - or the R5 row - 45/55, of the SAME table), with a setback per section 23-423. FAIL-CLOSED INPUT: applicability is conditional on the section 12-10 qualifying-residential-site test - geography the platform CANNOT evaluate from the canonical property_profile. qualifying_residential_site is therefore a REQUIRED input with no canonical source; when missing/unavailable the evaluation returns professional_review_required with NO value. The owner's research additionally flags that the ORDINARY transit-proximity qualifying route excludes R1/R2 (other routes, e.g. a community-facility floor-space condition as of 2024-12-05, can include them) - this rule does not assume either outcome; the qualifying determination is always the caller's/professional's, never guessed. This alternative COMPETES with the base-district height rules (r1-r2-bare-pitched-height / r1-r2-suffix-variants-pitched-height) for the shared max_building_height output; when both are simultaneously applicable the same-family conflict detector surfaces a rule_conflict and NO value is selected. Bare 'R1' and bare 'R2' outside the six symbols this rule's table row names, and R1-2A/R2A/R2X's shared-envelope caveats (D-049), do not affect this section - 23-424 stands on its own text. NOT a Verified determination.

citations.quote: R1-1 R1-2 R1-2A R2 R2A R2X R3-1 R3-2 R3A R3X | Maximum Base Height 35 | Maximum Height of Buildings or other Structures 35

A setback shall be provided in accordance with this Section. The depth of the setback shall be at least 10 feet from a street wall fronting on a wide street, and at least 15 feet from a street wall fronting on a narrow street.

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: Residence district governing the lot. Applicability is in_set the six R1/R2-series symbols this section's table row names (R1-1, R1-2, R1-2A, R2, R2A, R2X); bare 'R1' (not in this table row) and R3-series symbols (out of this family's scope - M4-T014's territory) are NOT matched here (visible not_applicable).

inputs.name: qualifying_residential_site
inputs.description: True iff the lot meets the section 12-10 'qualifying residential site' test. REQUIRED and FAIL-CLOSED: the test turns on lot area + Greater-Transit-Zone geography + frontage/short-block conditions + district exclusions (the owner's research notes the ORDINARY transit route specifically excludes R1/R2) that the canonical property_profile CANNOT establish, so in practice this is unavailable and the evaluation returns professional_review_required with no value. The alternative envelope is never assumed to apply.

inputs.name: overlay_present
inputs.description: True iff zoning.commercial_overlays[] is non-empty; when true -> professional_review_required (section 23-44).

inputs.name: special_district_present
inputs.description: True iff zoning.special_districts[] is non-empty; when true -> professional_review_required (section 23-44).

outputs.name: max_base_height
outputs.description: Alternative maximum base height (ft) on a qualifying residential site. Separate typed constraint; not a buildable-envelope result. Competes with the base-district envelope's max_building_height (this row carries no separate base-height output on the base-district side to compete with, since the pitched rules emit max_perimeter_wall_height/max_building_height, not max_base_height).

outputs.name: max_building_height
outputs.description: Alternative maximum building height (ft) on a qualifying residential site. Separate typed constraint; not a buildable-envelope result. Competes with the base-district max_building_height.

parameters.name: qrs_base_height_ft
parameters.note: Section 23-424 qualifying-residential-site maximum base height 35 ft (R1-1/R1-2/R1-2A/R2/R2A/R2X row). Candidate value pending raw-HTML verification and G6 approval.

parameters.name: qrs_building_height_ft
parameters.note: Section 23-424 qualifying-residential-site maximum building height 35 ft (R1-1/R1-2/R1-2A/R2/R2A/R2X row) - identical to the base height for this row, unlike the R4/R5 rows of the same table. Candidate value pending raw-HTML verification and G6 approval.

steps.note: Alternative maximum base height on a qualifying residential site (section 23-424).
Alternative maximum building height on a qualifying residential site (section 23-424).

exceptions.description: The section 23-424 alternative envelope requires a setback per section 23-423, whose depth is street-width conditional (10 wide / 15 narrow, section 12-10). That depth is a separate street-width-gated constraint and is not restated here.

The owner's research identified that the ordinary transit-proximity qualifying route under section 12-10 specifically EXCLUDES R1/R2 (other qualifying routes, e.g. a community-facility floor-space condition as of 2024-12-05, can include them). This rule does not assume either outcome; qualifying_residential_site must be independently established.
A commercial overlay may modify residence-district height (section 23-44); the value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.
A mapped special district may modify height (section 23-44); the value is not emitted as final. Professional review required.

uncertainty_policy.note: An uncertain, split, sliver, or invalid M2-T013 geometric district assignment is never collapsed into a single definitive district: coverage downgrades to professional_review_required (or data_conflict).

limitations: Draft extraction pending raw-HTML source verification and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.

Whether a lot is a 'qualifying residential site' (section 12-10) is a separate legal/geographic determination the platform cannot make from the canonical profile; without qualifying_residential_site the rule fails closed to professional_review_required. The ordinary transit-proximity route specifically excludes R1/R2; other routes may not.
This alternative competes with the base-district height rules for max_building_height; a same-family rule_conflict is surfaced rather than a silent precedence pick when both are applicable.
The section 23-423 setback for this envelope is a separate street-width-gated constraint, not restated here.

Bare 'R1' is not covered (it does not appear in this section's table row); R3-series symbols in the same printed row (R3-1, R3-2, R3A, R3X) are out of this family's scope (M4-T014's territory) and are deliberately not matched by this rule's applicability.
